
Flow cytometry data on mice experiments

#spleens
* suppl Fig5a 
for DCs, cDC1, cDC2, absolute counts and percentages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
library(readxl)

spln_all_results<- read_xlsx("../Data/Source_Data_flow.xlsx", sheet=4)



for (var in c("DCs_perc","cDC1_perc", "cDC2_perc","DCs", "cDC1","cDC2"  )) {
  if (grepl("_perc$", var)) {
    y_label <- paste0(sub("_perc$", "", var), " (%)")
    } else {
      y_label <- paste0(var, " (cells/ml)")
      }
  spln_all_results %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x=treatment, y=.data[[var]], color=treatment))+
    geom_boxplot(width=0.4, outlier.shape = NA, size=0.4)+
      geom_jitter(width=0.4, alpha=0.5)+
    theme_classic()+
    xlab("")+
    ylab(y_label)+
    scale_color_manual(values=c("grey20", "#2E9FDF", "#cf3131")) +
    stat_compare_means(comparisons=list(c("control","Vaccine"), c("Vaccine", "Vaccine_vanco"), c("control", "Vaccine_vanco"))) +
    theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size = 15, angle = 30, hjust = 1))+
    theme(legend.position = "none") 
}



```

# Ing LN
* suppl Fig 5b on CD19 in darining lymph node
```{r}

exp_all_ln_counts<- read_xlsx("../Data/Source_Data_flow.xlsx", sheet=5)

#for CD19_perc and CD19

exp_all_ln_counts %>% 
  mutate(CD19_perc=as.numeric(CD19_perc)) %>% 
  mutate(CD19=as.numeric(CD19)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=treatment, y=CD19_perc, color=treatment))+ 
  geom_boxplot(width=0.4, outlier.shape = NA, size=0.4)+
    geom_jitter(width=0.4, alpha=0.5) +
  theme_classic()+
  xlab("")+
  ylab("CD19%")+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("grey20", "#2E9FDF", "#cf3131")) +
  stat_compare_means(comparisons=list(c("control","Vaccine"), c("Vaccine", "Vaccine_vanco"), c("control", "Vaccine_vanco"))) +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size = 15, angle = 30, hjust = 1))+
  theme(legend.position = "none") 

exp_all_ln_counts %>% 
  mutate(CD19_perc=as.numeric(CD19_perc)) %>% 
  mutate(CD19=as.numeric(CD19)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=treatment, y=CD19, color=treatment))+ 
  geom_boxplot(width=0.4, outlier.shape = NA, size=0.4)+
    geom_jitter(width=0.4, alpha=0.5) +
  theme_classic()+
  xlab("")+
  ylab("CD19(cells/ml)")+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("grey20", "#2E9FDF", "#cf3131")) +
  stat_compare_means(comparisons=list(c("control","Vaccine"), c("Vaccine", "Vaccine_vanco"), c("control", "Vaccine_vanco"))) +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size = 15, angle = 30, hjust = 1))+
  theme(legend.position = "none")

```
